statement: Finite algebras over henselian Noetherian local rings with2unit are semiperfect; radical-subideal idempotents and hermitian isometries lift by finite commutative henselian square roots
depends_on: Stacks04GG; Stacks04GH; finite faithful-module unit reflection; QSS1979 Sections2–3
notes: Unit reflection from E to R[a] places the radical intersection in rad R[a]; finite henselian local factors lift idempotents through every K contained in J; selfadjoint roots replace completeness in form reduction

statement: Effective countable henselian DVRs with finite odd residue admit ordinary terminating canonical rational Om indices and complete split WG groups with equality products and exterior operations
depends_on: C:henselian-finite-algebra-lifting; C:integral-orthogonal-coalgebras; finite-field hermitian classification; exact DVR linear algebra
notes: Finite actual Hom residue images decide units and indecomposability; positive idempotent/isometry searches have proved existence; least finite codes remove every isomorphism quotient; no branch oracle

statement: The noncomplete henselization of Fq[t]_(t) has proved uniform exact finite-name arithmetic valuation division and field-compositum selection supplying the full ordinary WG algorithm
depends_on: C:effective-henselian-DVR-WG; C:function-field-factorization separable norm-shift proof; Stacks00UE; Stacks0BSK; Stacks0AP3; Stacks06LJ
notes: Pointed simple-root names cover the DVR; exactly one compositum factor vanishes and all others are eventually excluded by Laurent coefficients; all expressions stay in Frac(R); exact zero test precedes valuation search

statement: Every henselization of a finitely presented finite-field algebra at a supplied finite-residue closed point admits exact arithmetic and full Hom-kernel algorithms and hence complete ordinary canonical split WG classification
depends_on: C:henselian-finite-algebra-lifting; C:effective-henselian-DVR-WG proof with kernel generators; Stacks0BSK; Stacks07QL; Buchberger2001 Sections4.3–5.3
notes: Singular and nonreduced bases of arbitrary dimension included; annihilator generators decide localization equality; pointed etale flatness carries polynomial kernel generators to actual R-kernels; finite rings use a decidable name subset of N
